title: Send my money to my bank
summary: Move what the business's Taskiem wallet holds to its saved bank account, weekly or whenever it holds more than an amount, keeping an amount the owner chooses, and tell the owner how it went.
description: Made by Settings > Payments for a business that receives money with Taskiem (docs/spec/iswallet-account-numbers.md N2), not offered in the library: it pays without an approval step, which the library never does. It reads what the wallet holds, keeps the amount chosen and room for the bank's fee, and pays the rest, once per scheduled time, when that is at least the smallest amount, only to the bank account written into it. The owner is told when the bank confirms, or that it could not be paid.

params.name: bank_code
params.title: Bank
params.description: Your bank's code, such as 058 for GTBank.

params.name: account_number
params.title: Account number
params.description: Your 10-digit account number: the only place the money goes.

params.name: day
params.title: Day
params.description: The day of the week the money is sent.

params.name: send_time
params.title: Time
params.description: When the money is sent, Lagos time.

params.name: keep
params.title: Keep in the wallet (naira)
params.description: This much stays in the wallet; the rest is sent.

params.name: above
params.title: Only when the wallet holds more than (naira)
params.description: Nothing is sent unless the wallet holds more than this. 0 sends whenever there is enough.

params.name: minimum
params.title: Smallest amount to send (naira)
params.description: Less than this is left for next time.

params.name: fee_allowance
params.title: Room for the bank's fee (naira)
params.description: Left in the wallet to pay the transfer's fee.

params.name: rail_connection
params.title: Send from
params.description: The payments account the money is in: your Taskiem wallet, or any you connected that can pay a bank account.

params.name: funding_account
params.title: Wallet
params.description: Only for iswallet and Anchor, which hold several wallets: the one the money comes out of. Leave it blank otherwise.

definition.name: Send my money to my bank

steps.name: Find the name on your bank account
Tell the owner the money could not be sent

input.message: ='Sending NGN ' + string(double(steps.plan.output.amount_kobo) / 100.0) + ' to your bank could not be paid; nothing left your wallet. It is tried again next time.'

steps.name: Wait for the bank to confirm
Tell the owner how it went

input.message: ='Sent NGN ' + string(double(steps.plan.output.amount_kobo) / 100.0) + ' from your wallet to ' + steps.check_name.output.account_name + ': ' + (steps.sweep.output.status == 'settled' ? 'paid' : 'failed')

steps.name: Tell the owner how it went

input.message: ='Sent NGN ' + string(double(steps.plan.output.amount_kobo) / 100.0) + ' from your wallet to ' + steps.check_name.output.account_name + ': ' + (steps.settle.output.status == 'settled' ? 'paid' : steps.settle.output.status)
